children.text: Participants
Kuddle: Raunak
Thinkbyte: Raghu Gorrela, Harsha, vinay kovvuri
Key Takeaways
The meeting was focused on discussing the scaling of Raunak's pet services business into new cities and improving their social media management and ecommerce presence
Raunak expressed an urgent need to optimize social media strategies, enhance CRM for customer retention, and improve analytics for better attribution across marketing platforms
The sales team was tasked with creating a plan for the prospect's social media strategy with a specified budget and conducting an analytics report on paid accounts for optimization
A followup meeting was agreed upon to further discuss actionable solutions, although a specific date was not scheduled for the catchup in Bangalore

Raunak's company faces challenges such as efficiently transitioning users from the website to the app, underutilization of referral channels, and a past negative experience with agencies focusing on increased ad spending rather than optimization
Risk
Raunak is concerned about the efficiency of their social media strategy being time-consuming and bandwidth-intensive.
Past experiences with agencies have led to an increase in ad spend without optimization, creating a trust issue.
Background
Raunak is responsible for marketing and sales.
Operates a pet services company in Bangalore, expanding into e-commerce and physical stores.
Decision Maker
Raunak is a key decision-maker in marketing, sales, and customer service.
Plays a critical role in strategic and operational decisions related to marketing and growth initiatives.
Features Interested
Scale pet services business and strengthen ecommerce presence.
Explore new digital channels like Snapchat for customer acquisition.
Enhance retention strategies through improved CRM and communications.
Focus on social media strategy, attribution analytics, and customer retention techniques.
Improve website-to-app install conversion analytics.
Optimize marketing efforts through sales rep insights and actionable solutions discussions.
Business Goals
Expand to Delhi, Pune, and Ahmedabad within 3-6 months.
Develop a unique selling proposition (USP) for e-commerce while ensuring a clean profit and loss statement (P&L).
Focus on scaling the service business with proven market fit and high-quality operational delivery.
Impact
Scale pet services business by expanding to more cities and increasing stores in Bangalore.
Consider ecommerce expansion to complement services.
Priority Assessment
Scale services business and establish product-market fit for ecommerce platform.
Improve month-on-month repeat rate and frequency of service usage.
Current Workflow
Utilizes search ads to promote services and Meta for training services advertising.
Generates supply by advertising positions, training candidates, and offering employment.
Manages content creation for social media in-house.
Budget
Monthly marketing budget ranges from 8 to 10 lakhs.
Open to budget adjustments for effective solutions.
Considering allocating budget for a social media team.
Competitors
Market leaders like Google and Amazon are making their mark in the pet industry, highlighting the importance of a unique selling proposition (USP) to stand out.
Buying Process
Prioritizes a clean Profit and Loss (P&L) statement, especially for ecommerce.
Engaged with agencies for marketing strategies.
Open to exploring new marketing channels and strategies.
Evaluation Criteria
Optimization of ad copy and keywords for targeted prospects.
Evaluation of marketing channels' effectiveness in customer acquisition and retention.
Assessment of cost-effectiveness and ROI in social media management and paid advertising.
Measurement of each marketing channel's success.
Product Feedback
Improve utilization of referral channels for well-rated service with repeat customers.
Strengthen CRM strategies to boost customer retention.
Enhance attribution of marketing efforts across platforms.
Product Issues
Transitioning users from the company's website to the app is challenging, with a notable drop in installs after removing WhatsApp chat.
Team Size
The team includes people for social media, analytics, and social media strategy.
Pain Point
The challenge is that some booking websites lack control over post-service engagement and struggle with repetitive services, making it difficult to incorporate app-based features like live tracking.
Lack of synchronization between marketing, sales, and ESRR teams.
The Linkedin page is currently very limited and we still need to learn and optimize it.
The frequency of repeat customers needs improvement.
The team has not been able to figure out a referral channel for new user acquisition.
When using Meta and Google platforms, you cannot get access to the same user insights as Facebook and Google, which affects the overall understanding of the user.
The problem is that at Abslide, there is a lack of clear communication regarding the problem statement.
Drop off in sales conversion on the website and Whatsapp may impact retention.
Social media is a burning problem due to the amount of bandwidth it consumes.
